data.narration: Both quotes are in `vault/Projects/Home/Boiler-Quotes.md`. Writing the report now.
data.response:
**Pick Rossi Idraulica: 3,950 EUR all-in, 10-year warranty, fitted in two weeks.**

Report: `vault/Projects/Research/2026-10-14-0154-boiler-replacement-quotes.md`

| | Rossi Idraulica | TermoCasa |
|---|---|---|
| Total incl. VAT | **3,950 EUR** | 4,148 EUR |
| Warranty | 10 yr (yearly service) | 5 yr |
| Fitting | 2 weeks | Next week |

Why Rossi:
- **198 EUR cheaper** once VAT is counted; the 3,400 headline is misleading.
- Double the warranty, and the service condition is free since Marta already services it every November.
- Same Vaillant brand as the current unit, and she diagnosed the pressure drop herself.
- Only give-up is one week of waiting; the old boiler still runs and heating season hasn't started.

One check worth doing: ask TermoCasa whether residential fitting qualifies for the reduced 10% VAT. Even then they land around 3,740 EUR, still above Rossi, so this only sharpens the case.

If you go ahead, the Today.md item "Book the boiler service with Marta Rossi" can be folded into the replacement booking.
